example.pinyin: Wǒmen dā diàntī shàng lóu ba.

vocab.gloss: to scrape; to blow; to shave

example.pinyin: Wàimiàn guā dà fēng, jìde dài sǎn.
example.gloss: It's blowing hard outside, remember to take an umbrella.

example.pinyin: Wǒ dìdi bǐ wǒ ǎi yìdiǎn.
example.gloss: My younger brother is a little shorter than me.

example.hanzi: 我的眼鏡不見了，你有看到嗎？
example.pinyin: Wǒ de yǎnjìng bú jiàn le, nǐ yǒu kàndào ma?
example.gloss: My glasses are gone — have you seen them?
The weather in spring is very pleasant.

example.pinyin: Bīngxiāng lǐ yǒu niúnǎi hé jīdàn.
example.gloss: There's milk and eggs in the fridge.

grammar.title: 用「比」做比較
grammar.pattern: A + 比 + B + 形容詞（+ 一點／多了）
grammar.explanation: 「比」用來比較兩個人或兩樣東西。形容詞前面不能加「很」，要說「一點」或「多了」來表示差別大小，例如「他比我矮一點」。

examples.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei bǐ wǒ ǎi yìdiǎn.
examples.gloss: My younger sister is a bit shorter than me.

examples.hanzi: 這個冰箱比那個大多了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège bīngxiāng bǐ nàge dà duō le.
examples.gloss: This fridge is much bigger than that one.
Spring is more comfortable than summer.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 我的眼鏡呢？你看到了嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ de yǎnjìng ne? Nǐ kàndào le ma?
dialogue.gloss: Where are my glasses? Have you seen them?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.gloss: They're on top of the fridge.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 喔，找到了！外面刮大風，我要多穿一件。
dialogue.pinyin: Ō, zhǎodào le! Wàimiàn guā dà fēng, wǒ yào duō chuān yí jiàn.
dialogue.gloss: Oh, found them! It's windy outside, I'll wear one more layer.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒmen dā diàntī xià lóu ba.
dialogue.gloss: OK, let's take the elevator downstairs.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 電梯壞了耶，只能走樓梯。
dialogue.pinyin: Diàntī huài le ye, zhǐ néng zǒu lóutī.
dialogue.gloss: The elevator's broken — we can only take the stairs.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 沒關係，春天的天氣很舒服，走路也很好。
dialogue.pinyin: Méi guānxi, chūntiān de tiānqì hěn shūfú, zǒulù yě hěn hǎo.
dialogue.gloss: No problem, spring weather is nice, walking is good too.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān dā diàntī shàng bān.
sentences.gloss: I take the elevator to work every day.

sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān de fēng guā de hěn dà.
sentences.gloss: The wind is blowing very hard today.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng chuáng tài ǎi le.

sentences.gloss: There's no fruit left in the fridge.

example.pinyin: Wǒ āyí míngtiān yào lái wǒ jiā.
example.gloss: My aunt is coming to my house tomorrow.
I'm going to the supermarket to buy fruit.

vocab.gloss: to worry; to feel anxious; to feel a sense of urgency; to be in a hurry; Taiwan pr. [zhāo jí]

example.pinyin: Bié zhāojí, shíjiān hái hěn duō.
example.gloss: Don't worry, there's still plenty of time.

example.pinyin: Wǒ zuì ài de jìjié shì chūntiān.

vocab.gloss: air conditioning; air conditioner (including units that have a heating mode)

example.pinyin: Fángjiān lǐ de kōngtiáo huài le.
example.gloss: The air conditioner in the room is broken.

example.pinyin: Nǐ kàn, yuèliàng hǎo liàng ō!
example.gloss: Look, the moon is so bright!

grammar.title: 別 + Verb (Don't ...)
grammar.explanation: 別 means "don't" and is used before a verb to tell someone not to do something. It is softer and more spoken than 不要, and is very common in daily Taiwan Mandarin. Adding 了 at the end means "stop doing it now".

examples.pinyin: Bié zhāojí, wǒmen hái yǒu shíjiān.
examples.gloss: Don't worry, we still have time.

examples.hanzi: 別買太多，超市明天也開。
examples.pinyin: Bié mǎi tài duō, chāoshì míngtiān yě kāi.
examples.gloss: Don't buy too much; the supermarket is open tomorrow too.

examples.pinyin: Bié kāi kōngtiáo le, wàimiàn bù rè.
examples.gloss: Stop turning on the AC; it's not hot outside.

grammar.title: Time-word + 的 + Noun
grammar.pattern: 時間詞 + 的 + 名詞
grammar.explanation: A time word can modify a noun with 的, like 晚上的月亮 (the moon at night) or 這個季節的水果 (this season's fruit).

examples.gloss: The moon at night is very big.

examples.pinyin: Zhè ge jìjié de shuǐguǒ hěn tián.
examples.gloss: The fruit this season is very sweet.
Air conditioning in summer is very important.

dialogue.speaker: 阿姨
dialogue.hanzi: 就在前面，走五分鐘就到了。
dialogue.pinyin: Jiù zài qiánmiàn, zǒu wǔ fēnzhōng jiù dào le.
dialogue.gloss: It's just ahead; five minutes' walk and you're there.

dialogue.speaker: 小明
dialogue.hanzi: 我要買水果，還要買一點菜。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ yào mǎi shuǐguǒ, hái yào mǎi yìdiǎn cài.
dialogue.gloss: I want to buy fruit and also some vegetables.

dialogue.speaker: 阿姨
dialogue.hanzi: 別著急，超市晚上十點才關門。
dialogue.pinyin: Bié zhāojí, chāoshì wǎnshàng shí diǎn cái guānmén.
dialogue.gloss: Don't rush; the supermarket doesn't close until ten at night.

dialogue.speaker: 小明
dialogue.hanzi: 對了，這個季節的水果很甜喔！
dialogue.pinyin: Duì le, zhè ge jìjié de shuǐguǒ hěn tián ō!
dialogue.gloss: By the way, the fruit this season is really sweet!

dialogue.speaker: 阿姨
dialogue.hanzi: 是啊！買完回家開空調，晚上還可以看月亮。
dialogue.pinyin: Shì a! Mǎi wán huí jiā kāi kōngtiáo, wǎnshàng hái kěyǐ kàn yuèliàng.
dialogue.gloss: Yes! After shopping we'll go home and turn on the AC; at night we can also look at the moon.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ āyí zài chāoshì mǎi cài.
sentences.gloss: My aunt buys vegetables at the supermarket.

sentences.pinyin: Bié zhāojí, chē kuài lái le.
sentences.gloss: Don't worry, the bus is coming soon.

sentences.pinyin: Chūntiān shì zuì shūfú de jìjié.
sentences.gloss: Spring is the most comfortable season.

sentences.pinyin: Fángjiān lǐ de kōngtiáo huài le.
sentences.gloss: The air conditioner in the room is broken.
The moon at night is very bright.

vocab.gloss: north; the northern part a country; China north of the Yellow River

example.pinyin: Běifāng de dōngtiān chángcháng xià xuě.
example.gloss: It often snows in the north in winter.

vocab.gloss: to like; to be fond of; to take pleasure in; to be keen on; interest; hobby

example.pinyin: Zhè jiàn bái chènshān hěn hǎokàn.
example.gloss: This white shirt looks really nice.

example.hanzi: 我們在火車站附近找了一家旅館。
example.pinyin: Wǒmen zài huǒchēzhàn fùjìn zhǎo le yì jiā lǚguǎn.
example.gloss: We found a hotel near the train station.

example.pinyin: Dōngtiān de zǎoshang hěn nán qǐchuáng.
example.gloss: It's hard to get out of bed on winter mornings.

example.hanzi: 她穿了一條藍色的裙子。
example.pinyin: Tā chuān le yì tiáo lán sè de qúnzi.
example.gloss: She is wearing a blue skirt.

grammar.title: 我的愛好是＋動詞短語 (My hobby is ...)
grammar.pattern: （某人）的愛好是 ＋ 動詞短語
grammar.explanation: 愛好 is a noun meaning 'hobby / interest'. Use 「(某人)的愛好是…」 to say what someone likes doing. After 是 you put a verb phrase such as 游泳, 跳舞, 逛街. To ask, say 「你的愛好是什麼？」

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de àihào shì huà huà.
Wǒ jiějie de àihào shì chàng gē.
examples.gloss: My older sister's hobby is singing.

examples.hanzi: 你的愛好是什麼？我的愛好是騎腳踏車。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de àihào shì shénme? Wǒ de àihào shì qí jiǎotàchē.
examples.gloss: What's your hobby? My hobby is riding a bike.

grammar.title: 冬天＋穿／喝… (talking about seasons)
grammar.pattern: 冬天 ＋ 主語 ＋ 動詞
grammar.explanation: 冬 means winter; in daily speech Taiwanese people usually say 冬天. A season word like 冬天 often comes at the front of the sentence as a time word, before the subject or right after it.

examples.pinyin: Dōngtiān wǒ hěn ài hē rè chá.
examples.gloss: In winter I really love drinking hot tea.
She still wears skirts in winter.

examples.hanzi: 北方的冬天，人人都穿長褲。
examples.pinyin: Běifāng de dōngtiān, rénrén dōu chuān chángkù.
examples.gloss: In the northern winter, everyone wears long pants.

dialogue.speaker: 小明
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ kàn, zhè jiàn chènshān hǎokàn ma?
dialogue.gloss: Look, does this shirt look good?

dialogue.speaker: 阿文
dialogue.hanzi: 好看！不過我比較愛那條裙子。
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎokàn! Búguò wǒ bǐjiào ài nà tiáo qúnzi.
dialogue.gloss: It's nice! But I like that skirt more.

dialogue.speaker: 小明
dialogue.hanzi: 冬天穿裙子，你不怕風喔？
dialogue.pinyin: Dōngtiān chuān qúnzi, nǐ bú pà fēng o?
dialogue.gloss: Wearing a skirt in winter — you're not afraid of the wind?

dialogue.speaker: 阿文
dialogue.hanzi: 我是北方人，北方的冬天我都習慣了。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ shì běifāng rén, běifāng de dōngtiān wǒ dōu xíguàn le.
dialogue.gloss: I'm a northerner; I'm used to northern winters.

dialogue.speaker: 小明
dialogue.hanzi: 那你買吧！我們還要回旅館。
dialogue.pinyin: Nà nǐ mǎi ba! Wǒmen hái yào huí lǚguǎn.
dialogue.gloss: Then buy it! We still have to go back to the hotel.

dialogue.speaker: 阿文
dialogue.hanzi: 好啦，我的愛好就是逛街買東西。
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo la, wǒ de àihào jiùshì guàng jiē mǎi dōngxi.
dialogue.gloss: Fine, my hobby is exactly shopping on the street.

sentences.pinyin: Běifāng de dōngtiān chángcháng xià xuě.
sentences.gloss: It often snows in the north in winter.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn chènshān tài guì le.
Wǒmen zhù zài chēzhàn fùjìn de lǚguǎn.
sentences.gloss: We're staying at the hotel near the station.

sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng mǎi yì tiáo xīn qúnzi.
sentences.gloss: She wants to buy a new skirt.
